up: Identify activity records where compounds have an exact IC50 measurement (standard_type = 'IC50' and standard_relation = '=') with a non-null pChEMBL value (pChEMBL = standard_value converted to log10). Filter to human single-protein targets (target_dictionary.target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN', target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1966') and restrict activities to compounds with a molecule_chembl_id (e.g., CHEMBLxxx). Return the assay ChEMBL ID, the target type, the organism tax_id from target_dictionary, the canonical SMILES of the compound (from compound_structures.canonical_smiles), the molecule ChEMBL ID (from molecule_dictionary.chembl_id), the standard type (standard_type), and the pChEMBL value (pChEMBL = standard_value converted to log10 using standard_units where standard_units is nM, converting nM to M with /1e9). Results must be ordered by molecule ChEMBL ID and assay ChEMBL ID. Return the first 1000 rows of the ordered list.
sql:
WITH filtered_activities AS (
  SELECT 
    a.assay_id AS assay_chembl_id,
    a.standard_type,
    a.standard_value,
    a.standard_units,
    a.molecule_chembl_id,
    a.activity_id,
    a.pchembl_value,
    a.bao_endpoint,
    a.uo_units,
    a.qudt_units,
    a.toid,
    a.upper_value,
    a.type,
    a.relation,
    a.value,
    a.units,
    a.text_value,
    a.standard_text_value,
    a.standard_flag,
    a.potential_duplicate,
    a.bao_endpoint,
    a.uo_units,
    a.qudt_units,
    a.toid,
    a.upper_value,
    a.standard_type,
    a.standard_relation,
    a.standard_value,
    a.standard_units,
    a.standard_text_value,
    a.standard_flag,
    a.potential_duplicate,
    a.data_validity_comment,
    a.activity_comment,
    a.standard_type,
    a.standard_relation,
    a.standard_value,
    a.standard_units,
    a.standard_text_value,
    a.standard_flag,
    a.potential_duplicate,
    a.data_validity_comment,
    a.activity_comment,
    a.standard_type,
    a.standard_relation,
    a.standard_value,
    a.standard_units,
    a.standard_text_value,
    a.standard_flag,
    a.potential_duplicate,
    a.data_validity_comment,
    a.activity_comment
  FROM activities a
  JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
  JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
  JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molecule_chembl_id = cs.molecule_chembl_id
  WHERE
    td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1966'
    AND a.standard_type = 'IC50'
    AND a.standard_relation = '='
    AND a.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL
    AND td.target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN'
    AND a.standard_units = 'nM'
    AND a.standard_value > 0
), converted AS (
  SELECT
    assay_chembl_id,
    standard_type,
    molecule_chembl_id,
    canonical_smiles,
    pChEMBL_value,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY molecule_chembl_id, assay_chembl_id) AS rn
  FROM (
    SELECT
      a.assay_chembl_id,
      a.standard_type,
      a.molecule_chembl_id,
      cs.canonical_smiles,
      a.pchembl_value,
      (a.standard_value / 1e9) AS pChEMBL_value_converted
    FROM filtered_activities a
    LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molecule_chembl_id = cs.molecule_chembl_id
  )
  WHERE pChEMBL_value_converted IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  assay_chembl_id,
  'SINGLE PROTEIN' AS target_type,
  td.tax_id AS organism_tax_id,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id,
  standard_type,
  pChEMBL_value_converted AS pChEMBL
FROM converted c
JOIN filtered_activities fa ON c.rn = fa.activity_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON fa.molecule_chembl_id = md.molregno
LEFT JOIN assays ass ON fa.assay_chembl_id = ass.assay_chembl_id
LEFT JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON fa.molecule_chembl_id = cs.molecule_chembl_id
WHERE c.rn <= 1000
ORDER BY molecule_chembl_id, assay_chembl_id;
